The Science
What is Photo Facial?

Photo Facial is a powerful Intense Pulsed Light (IPL) treatment that uses broad-spectrum light energy to target and eliminate pigmentation, redness, sun damage, age spots, and broken capillaries â leaving skin clearer, brighter, and more youthful. It's the celebrity-favorite way to turn back the clock on sun-damaged skin.

Unlike single-wavelength lasers, IPL delivers multiple wavelengths simultaneously â targeting both melanin (pigmentation) and hemoglobin (redness/veins) in one treatment. The light is absorbed by these targeted chromophores, breaking them down so the body can naturally eliminate them.

At ISAAC Luxe, our expert dermatologists use advanced IPL technology with precise energy settings customized for your skin type. Perfect for addressing multiple concerns simultaneously â sun damage, freckles, melasma, rosacea, broken capillaries, and overall dullness â in a single 30-minute session.

IPL Science
How Does It Work?

Broad-Spectrum Light

IPL delivers multiple wavelengths of light simultaneously â between 500â1200 nm. These wavelengths selectively target melanin (pigment) and hemoglobin (blood vessels) while sparing surrounding tissue. Advanced filters customize the treatment for each specific concern.

Selective Photothermolysis

The light energy is absorbed by pigmentation and blood vessels, converting to heat that destroys the targeted structures. Broken-down pigment is naturally flushed away by the body. Damaged blood vessels collapse and disappear. Clearer skin reveals itself.

The Photo Facial Process
1

Skin Assessment

Our dermatologist evaluates your skin type, pigmentation patterns, vascular concerns. Customizes IPL settings for safe, effective results.

2

Prep & Gel

Skin is cleansed thoroughly. Protective cooling gel is applied, and protective eyewear provided for comfort and safety during the session.

3

IPL Application

The IPL handpiece is passed over treatment areas, delivering precise light pulses. You feel a mild snapping sensation. Session takes 20â30 minutes.

4

Resume Your Day

Pigmentation darkens initially (like coffee grounds) â this is normal and shows the IPL is working. Spots flake off over 7â10 days, revealing clearer skin. Full results visible at 4 weeks.

Your Questions Answered
Frequently Asked Questions

Does Photo Facial hurt?

Most clients describe it as a mild snapping sensation â like a rubber band lightly hitting the skin. Very tolerable, no numbing cream typically needed. Session takes 20â30 minutes.

How soon will I see results?

Some patients feel improvements immediately after the first session â increased muscle firmness and toning. Visible fat reduction typically appears 2â4 weeks after completing all 4 sessions, with optimal results at 2â3 months as fat cells are naturally eliminated.

How many sessions for melasma?

Melasma typically requires 4â6 sessions spaced 3â4 weeks apart. However, melasma can be stubborn â we often combine IPL with other treatments like Cosmelan peel for comprehensive results.

Can I combine it with other treatments?

Yes! Emsculpt NEO pairs excellently with treatments like CoolSculpting, Exilis Elite, and lymphatic drainage. Our experts at ISAAC Luxe can design a comprehensive body contouring plan tailored to your goals.

Can I combine it with other treatments?

Yes! Photo Facial pairs beautifully with HydraFacial, chemical peels, Rejuran, and AQUAGOLD. Dr. Geetika creates combined protocols for comprehensive skin clearance and rejuvenation.

How long do results last?

Results last 1â2 years with proper sun protection. New sun damage will require additional sessions, so we recommend 2 maintenance sessions yearly. Strict daily SPF use extends results significantly.
